enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Falls asleep. Sleeps.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing, and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up in bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Uses toilet. Flushes toilet. Turns on tap. Washes hands. Rinses hands. Turns off tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Dries face with towel. Takes off pajamas. Puts on clothes. Turns off bathroom light. Walks out of bathroom.

Walks into kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs and milk. Closes refrigerator. Takes out bowl and pan. Turns on InductionCooker. Pours oil into pan. Crack eggs into bowl. Beats eggs. Pours eggs into pan. Cooks eggs. Turns off InductionCooker. Places eggs on plate. Pours milk into glass. Sits at table. Eats eggs. Drinks milk. Cleans dishes. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting ready for work and packing bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bedroom. Opens closet. Takes out work shirt. Takes out pants. Closes closet. Takes off shirt. Puts on work shirt. Puts on pants. Opens drawer. Takes out socks. Puts on socks. Takes out shoes from closet. Puts on shoes. Opens backpack. Picks up computer. Places computer in backpack. Picks up phone. Places phone in pocket. Picks up charger. Places charger in backpack. Zips backpack. Picks up backpack. Turns off DeskLamp. Walks out of bedroom.

Walks out of house. Walks to bus stop. Stands at bus stop. Takes out phone. Checks time. Puts phone in pocket. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Takes out phone. Opens music app. Plays music. Puts phone in pocket. Listens to music. Bus stops. Gets off bus. Walks to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit office, coordinating community programs
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at office. Walks to desk. Sits down. Turns on computer. Logs in. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Opens calendar. Checks schedule. Picks up phone. Dials number. Talks on phone. Hangs up. Opens document. Types report. Saves document. Attends meeting. Takes notes. Returns to desk.

Walks to break room. Opens refrigerator. Takes out lunch bag. Closes refrigerator. Sits at table. Opens lunch bag. Takes out sandwich. Unwraps sandwich. Eats sandwich. Drinks water. Throws away trash. Walks outside. Sits on bench. Closes eyes. Rests. Opens eyes. Stands up. Walks back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit office, coordinating community programs
enriched_activities.desc: Returns to desk. Sits down. Opens computer. Checks email. Opens document. Edits document. Saves document. Picks up phone. Makes phone call. Talks on phone. Hangs up. Meets with colleague. Discusses program. Takes notes. Returns to desk. Updates database. Prints documents. Collects printouts. Files documents. Organizes desk.

Walks out of office. Walks to bus stop. Stands at bus stop. Takes out phone. Checks time. Puts phone in pocket. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Takes out phone. Checks messages. Puts phone in pocket. Bus stops. Gets off bus. Walks home. Walks into house.

Walks into kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out ingredients. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out cutting board. Takes out knife. Cuts ingredients. Turns on InductionCooker. Pours oil into pan. Adds ingredients. Cooks dinner. Turns off InductionCooker. Places dinner on plate. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Cleans dishes. Turns off light. Walks out.

Walks into living room. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Watches TV. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads book. Closes book. Turns off TV. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out water. Closes refrigerator. Drinks water. Walks back to living room. Sits on couch.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing household chores and tidying up
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up. Picks up vacuum cleaner. Turns on vacuum cleaner. Vacuums floor. Turns off vacuum cleaner. Puts away vacuum cleaner. Picks up items from floor. Places items in cabinet. Wipes coffee table with cloth. Throws away trash. Organizes magazines. Fluffs pillows. Folds blanket. Places blanket on couch. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom.

Walks into bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on WaterHeater. Waits for water to heat. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body with soap. Rinses body. Washes hair with shampoo. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Wraps towel around body. Turns off WaterHeater. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Walks into bedroom. Turns on DeskLamp. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads book. Turns page. Continues reading. Closes book. Places book on nightstand. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts phone on nightstand. Turns off DeskLamp. Lies down on bed.
Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Falls asleep. Sleeps.
